name: What is an elevated deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: An elevated deck is a deck structure built above ground level, often requiring support posts and railings. Unlike ground-level decks, elevated decks are typically constructed when the adjacent living space is on a second story or a sloped lot, providing direct access from upper floors. The design must consider the height, foundation requirements, and local building codes for safety and structural integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: An elevated deck is a deck structure built above ground level, connecting to a second story or for use on sloped lots.
